1. Front country RX Data pre-processing
Fuels
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load fuels data frames
fuels25sp <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Spring25RX_fuels_report.csv") %>%
pivot_longer(cols=4:16, names_to="FuelCategory", values_to="value") %>%
filter(FuelCategory %in% c("OneHr","TenHr","HunHr","FineWood","ThoHr_Snd","ThoHr_Rot","TotalWood","Duff","Litter","TotalAll")) %>% mutate(Burn = "HQ_Spring25")

fuels24f <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall24RX_fuels_report.csv") %>%
pivot_longer(cols=4:16, names_to="FuelCategory", values_to="value") %>%
filter(FuelCategory %in% c("OneHr","TenHr","HunHr","FineWood","ThoHr_Snd","ThoHr_Rot","TotalWood","Duff","Litter","TotalAll")) %>% mutate(Burn = "HQ_Fall24")

fuels25f <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall25RX_fuels_report.csv") %>% 
  add_row(Plot = "PIPO_09", MonStatus = "02POST", OneHr = 0.06693385, TenHr = 1.4481455, HunHr = 0.9973587, FineWood = 2.5124380, ThoHr_Snd = 0, ThoHr_Rot = 0, TotalWood = 2.5124380, Duff = 4.142737, Litter = 3.843262, TotalAll = 10.498438, DuffDep = 0.415, LittDep = 0.77, TotDep = 1.185 )%>% 
  add_row(Plot = "PIPO_27", MonStatus = "02POST", OneHr = 0.06984402, TenHr = .7101483, HunHr = 0.3324529, FineWood = 1.1124452, ThoHr_Snd = 0, ThoHr_Rot = 0, TotalWood = 1.1124452, Duff = 3.044662, Litter = 4.067869, TotalAll = 8.224976, DuffDep = 0.305, LittDep = 0.815, TotDep = 1.12 )%>% 
pivot_longer(cols=4:16, names_to="FuelCategory", values_to="value") %>% rename(Macroplot = Plot) %>%
filter(FuelCategory %in% c("OneHr","TenHr","HunHr","FineWood","ThoHr_Snd","ThoHr_Rot","TotalWood","Duff","Litter","TotalAll")) %>% 
  mutate(Burn = case_when(Macroplot %in% c("PIPO_09", "PIPO_27", "PIPS_14") ~ "HQ_Fall25", TRUE ~ "BM_Fall25"))

# Combine and format
fuels <- bind_rows(fuels24f, fuels25sp, fuels25f) %>% dplyr::select(-1)
fuels <- fuels %>% 
  mutate(FuelCategory=factor(FuelCategory,levels=c("OneHr","TenHr","HunHr","FineWood","ThoHr_Snd","ThoHr_Rot","TotalWood","Duff","Litter","TotalAll")))%>%
  mutate(MonStatus = case_when(MonStatus %in% c("00PRE","01PRE", "02PRE") ~ "PRE", MonStatus %in% c("03POST", "02POST", "01POST") ~ "POST", TRUE ~ "01YR01"))
fuels$MonStatus <- factor(fuels$MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST", "01YR01"), ordered = TRUE)

fuels[is.na(fuels)] <- 0


write.csv(fuels, "Biennial/rx_fuels.csv")



```

```{r}
# Load Data & Combine

  mutate(Burn = "Spring25")

spcover <- cover %>% group_by(Plot, Status2) %>% mutate(hpp = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(Plot, Status2, Species, Burn, FuncGroup, Native, SpeciesName) %>% summarise(HitsPerPlot = first(hpp), Hits = n(), PctCover=(n()/HitsPerPlot*100), .groups = "drop") 

fgcover <- cover %>% group_by(Plot, Status2) %>% mutate(hpp = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(Plot, Status2,Burn, FuncGroup, Native) %>% 
  summarise(HitsPerPlot = first(hpp), FGHits = n(), FGPctCover=(n()/HitsPerPlot*100), .groups = "drop") 

cover <- left_join(spcover, fgcover)
cover <- cover %>% mutate(Status2 = case_when(Status2 %in% c("00PRE", "PreBurn") ~ "PreBurn", Status2 == "01YR01" ~ "PostBurn"))


write.csv(cover, "Biennial2026/Data/rx_cover.csv")

shrub <- cover %>% filter(FuncGroup == "Shrub") %>% group_by(Plot, Status2, Burn, SpeciesName, Species) %>% summarise(hits = n(), PctCover = (n()/40)*100, .groups = "drop")

write.csv(shrub, "Biennial2026/Data/rx_shrub.csv")
```

Trees
```{r}
# Load data and combine
trees1 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Spring25RX_trees_data.csv") %>% rename(Plot = MacroPlot.Name) %>% mutate(Burn = "Spring25")
trees2 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall24RX_trees_data.csv") %>% mutate(Burn = "Fall24")
trees3 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall25RX_trees_data.csv") %>% mutate(Burn = "Fall25")
trees <- bind_rows(trees1, trees2, trees3)

# Format
trees <- trees %>% dplyr::select(2,3,6:15, 19:22) %>%mutate(TreeBA_ft2 = (pi*(DBH/200)^2)*10.7639, PlotArea_Acres = 0.079) 
trees <- trees %>% mutate(Status2 = case_when(Status2 == "00PRE" ~ "PreBurn", Status2 == "01YR01" ~ "1YrPostBurn", TRUE ~ Status2))
trees$Status2 <- factor(trees$Status2, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn", "1YrPostBurn"))


write.csv(trees, "Biennial2026/Data//rx_trees.csv")




```

1. Fuels 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# (1) Read in fuels data
fuels <- read.csv("Data/rx_fuels.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-1)
fuels$MonStatus <- factor(fuels$MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST", "01YR01"), ordered = TRUE)


fuels <- fuels %>% mutate(Burn = case_when(Burn == "HQ_Fall24" ~ "Fall 2024", Burn == "HQ_Spring25" ~ "Spring 2025",
                                     Burn == "BM_Fall25" ~ "Fall 2025 Beaver Meadows", Burn ==  "HQ_Fall25" ~ "Fall 2025 HQ"))
fuels$Burn <- factor(fuels$Burn, levels = c("Fall 2024", "Spring 2025", "Fall 2025 Beaver Meadows", "Fall 2025 HQ"))


# (2) Table showing fuel consumption
tbl <- fuels %>% filter(FuelCategory %in% c("FineWood", "Litter", "Duff", "TotalAll")) %>% filter(MonStatus %in% c("PRE", "POST")) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Macroplot, FuelCategory, Burn), names_from = MonStatus, values_from = value) %>% mutate(Change = POST - PRE, PctChange = round(((POST-PRE)/PRE)*100,1)) %>% group_by(FuelCategory,Burn) %>%summarise(MeanValue = round(mean(PctChange, na.rm=TRUE),1), .groups="drop") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = FuelCategory, values_from = MeanValue)%>% dplyr::select(Burn, FineWood, Litter, Duff, TotalAll) %>% rename(TotalSurfaceFuels = TotalAll, FineWoody = FineWood)

tbl$Burn <- factor(tbl$Burn, levels = c("Fall 2024", "Spring 2025", "Fall 2025 Beaver Meadows", "Fall 2025 HQ"))
tbl <- tbl %>% arrange(Burn)

tbl_avg <- tbl %>% summarise(Burn = "Average", across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
tbl2 <- bind_rows(tbl, tbl_avg)
tbl2 <- tbl2 %>% mutate(Burn = case_when(Burn == "Fall 2024" ~ "1. Fall 2024", Burn == "Spring 2025" ~ "2. Spring 2025",
                                         Burn == "Fall 2025 Beaver Meadows" ~ "3. Fall 2025 Beaver Meadows", Burn == "Fall 2025 HQ" ~ "4. Fall 2025 HQ", .default = Burn))

# GT TABLE with simple bold average row + divider
tbl_gt <- tbl2 %>% gt(auto_align = FALSE) %>% tab_header(title = "Percent Fuel Consumption (Pre- vs. Post-Burn)") %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(rows = Burn == "Average")) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_column_labels(everything()))

tbl_gt

##########
# Calculate stats for plots
fuels2 <- fuels  %>% filter(FuelCategory %in% c("FineWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")) %>% mutate(value = sqrt(value)) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Macroplot, MonStatus, Burn), names_from = FuelCategory, values_from = value)
fuels2 <- fuels2 %>% mutate(MonStatus = factor(MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST", "01YR01")))
fuel_vars <- c("FineWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")


#Pairwise comparisons between pre and post
pairwise_results <- map_dfr(fuel_vars, function(var) {
  m <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(var, " ~ MonStatus*Burn + (1|Macroplot)")), data = fuels2)
  em <- emmeans(m, pairwise ~ MonStatus | Burn, adjust = "BH")
  
  as.data.frame(em$contrasts) %>%
    mutate(FuelCategory = var) %>%
    dplyr::select(Burn, FuelCategory, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value)
})

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>% mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 2),SE = round(SE, 2),t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 2),p.value = round(p.value, 3))


# Plot Fuel Loads
fuelplot <- fuels %>% filter(FuelCategory %in% c("FineWood", "Litter", "Duff", "TotalAll")) %>% group_by(MonStatus, Burn, FuelCategory) %>% 
  summarise(mean = round(mean(value), 1), sd = round(sd(value), 1), .groups = "drop")
fuelplot$Burn <- factor(fuelplot$Burn, levels = c("Fall 2024", "Spring 2025", "Fall 2025 Beaver Meadows", "Fall 2025 HQ"))
fuelplot <- fuelplot %>% arrange(Burn)
fuelplot <- fuelplot %>% mutate(FuelCategory = case_when(FuelCategory == "FineWood" ~ "Fine Woody", FuelCategory == "TotalAll" ~ "Total", .default = FuelCategory))
fuelplot$FuelCategory <- factor(fuelplot$FuelCategory, levels = c("Fine Woody", "Litter", "Duff", "Total"))

# plot1: pre vs post
plot1 <- fuelplot %>% filter(MonStatus %in% c("PRE", "POST"))

ggplot(plot1, aes(x = FuelCategory, y = mean, fill = MonStatus)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9))+ geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean - sd,0), ymax = mean + sd),position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.2) + facet_wrap(~Burn)+ scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal)+ theme_nps() + labs(title="Surface Fuel loads pre-burn vs. post-burn", y="Avg. Fuel Load (tons/acre)", x = "Fuel Category", fill = "Monitoring Status") +theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))

#need to add significance stars to:
# Fall24: litter < 0.05, duff < 0.1, total < 0.05
# Spring25: fine woody < 0.1, litter < 0.05, total < 0.05
# BM: fine woody < 0.1, litter < 0.05, duff < 0.05, total < 0.05
# HQ: nothin

#create stars based on p values
plot1_stats <- pairwise_results %>% filter(contrast == "PRE - POST") %>% dplyr::select(c(1:3, 8))
sig_df <- plot1_stats %>%mutate(label = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",TRUE ~ "")) %>%filter(label != "")
sig_df <- sig_df %>% mutate(FuelCategory = case_when(FuelCategory == "TotalAll" ~ "Total", .default = FuelCategory))
#calculate position to place stars on plot
y_positions <- plot1 %>%group_by(FuelCategory, Burn) %>%summarise(y_pos = max(mean + sd) * 1.1, .groups = "drop")
sig_df <- left_join(sig_df, y_positions,by = c("FuelCategory", "Burn"))

#Now add this to plot
ggplot(plot1, aes(x = FuelCategory, y = mean, fill = MonStatus)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9))+ geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean - sd,0), ymax = mean + sd),position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.2) + 
  facet_wrap(~Burn, labeller = labeller(Burn = function(x) {paste0(match(x, unique(x)), ". ", x)}))+ 
  scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal)+ theme_nps() + labs(title="Surface Fuel loads pre-burn vs. post-burn", y="Avg. Fuel Load (tons/acre)", x = "Fuel Category", fill = "Monitoring Status") +theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1)) + 
  geom_text(data = sig_df, aes(x = FuelCategory, y = y_pos, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6)

#### Now I want to do the same thing but just for the 2 burns that have all 3 time points
#Plot 2
plot2 <- fuelplot %>% filter(Burn %in% c("Fall 2024", "Spring 2025"))

plot2_stats <- pairwise_results %>% filter(Burn %in% c("Fall 2024", "Spring 2025"))%>% dplyr::select(c(1:3, 8))
sig_df2 <- plot2_stats %>%mutate(label = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",TRUE ~ "")) %>%filter(label != "")
sig_df2 <- sig_df2 %>% mutate(FuelCategory = case_when(FuelCategory == "TotalAll" ~ "Total", .default = FuelCategory))

  facet_wrap(~Burn, labeller = labeller(Burn = function(x) {paste0(match(x, unique(x)), ". ", x)}))+

  geom_text(data = sig_df2, aes(x = FuelCategory, y = y_pos, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6)

# (4) Stats

# Format data for stats: Log-transform, 
fuels2 <- fuels %>% filter(MonStatus %in% c("PRE", "POST")) %>% filter(FuelCategory %in% c("FineWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")) %>% mutate(value = sqrt(value)) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Macroplot, MonStatus, Burn), names_from = FuelCategory, values_from = value)
fuels2 <- fuels2 %>% mutate(MonStatus = factor(MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST")))
fuel_vars <- c("FineWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")

fuels2 <- fuels  %>% filter(FuelCategory %in% c("FineWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")) %>% mutate(value = sqrt(value)) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Macroplot, MonStatus, Burn), names_from = FuelCategory, values_from = value)
fuels2 <- fuels2 %>% mutate(MonStatus = factor(MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST", "01YR01")))
fuel_vars <- c("FineWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")


#Pairwise comparisons between pre and post
pairwise_results <- map_dfr(fuel_vars, function(var) {
  m <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(var, " ~ MonStatus*Burn + (1|Macroplot)")), data = fuels2)
  em <- emmeans(m, pairwise ~ MonStatus | Burn, adjust = "BH")
  
  as.data.frame(em$contrasts) %>%
    mutate(FuelCategory = var) %>%
    dplyr::select(Burn, FuelCategory, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value)
})

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>% mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 2),SE = round(SE, 2),t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 2),p.value = round(p.value, 3))

# Tables
a <- pairwise_results%>% filter(Burn == "BM_Fall25") %>% dplyr::select(-c(contrast, Burn)) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "BM_Fall25 Fuel Loads Pre vs. Post Burn") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.05))

b <- pairwise_results%>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Fall25") %>% dplyr::select(-c(contrast, Burn)) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "HQ_Fall25 Fuel Loads Pre vs. Post Burn") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.05))

c <- pairwise_results%>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Spring25") %>% dplyr::select(-c(contrast, Burn)) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "HQ_Spring25 Fuel Loads Pre vs. Post Burn") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.05))

d <- pairwise_results%>% filter(Burn == "HQ_Fall24") %>% dplyr::select(-c(contrast, Burn)) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "HQ_Fall24 Fuel Loads Pre vs. Post Burn") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.05))

ggarrange(a, b, c, d, ncol = 1)
```

```{r}
# Read in data
trees <- read.csv("Data/rx_trees.csv")

# Filter out post-burn fire effects tree data
fire <- trees %>% dplyr::select(Plot, Status2, Burn, Live.Crown.Base.Ht., Char.Ht., Scorch.Ht., Crown.Scorch..) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(Char.Ht., Scorch.Ht., Crown.Scorch.., Live.Crown.Base.Ht.), names_to = "Measurement", values_to = "value")
fire <- fire %>% mutate(Status2 = case_when(Status2 == "PreBurn" ~ "PRE", Status2 == "PostBurn" ~ "POST", Status2 == "1YrPostBurn" ~ "01YR01")) %>%
  mutate(Burn = case_when(Plot %in% c("PIPS_02", "PIPS_05") ~ "BMFall25", Plot %in% c("PIPO_27", "PIPO_09", "PIPS_14") ~ "HQFall25", .default = Burn)) %>%
  mutate(Burn = case_when(Burn == "Fall24" ~ "1. Fall 2024", Burn == "Spring25" ~ "2. Spring 2025", Burn == "BMFall25" ~ "3. Fall 2025 Beaver Meadows", 
                          Burn == "HQFall25" ~ "4. Fall 2025 HQ"))
fire <- fire %>% mutate(Measurement = case_when(Measurement == "Char.Ht." ~ "Char Height (m)", Measurement == "Crown.Scorch.." ~ "Percent Crown Scorch", 
                                                Measurement == "Scorch.Ht." ~ "Scorch Height (m)", Measurement == "Live.Crown.Base.Ht." ~ "Canopy Base Height (m)"))
fire$Status2 <- factor(fire$Status2, levels = c("PRE", "POST", "01YR01"))
fire$Burn <- factor(fire$Burn, levels = c("1. Fall 2024", "2. Spring 2025", "3. Fall 2025 Beaver Meadows", "4. Fall 2025 HQ"))

# plot 1: bole char, scorch height, % scorch for 3 burns
plot1 <- fire %>% filter(Status2 == "POST") %>% filter(Measurement != "Canopy Base Height (m)")

plot1 <- plot1 %>% group_by(Burn, Measurement) %>% summarise(mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value), .groups = "drop")
plot1$Measurement <- factor(plot1$Measurement, levels = c("Char Height (m)", "Scorch Height (m)", "Percent Crown Scorch"))

ggplot(plot1, aes(x = Measurement, y = mean, fill = Measurement)) + geom_col() + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean - sd,0), ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) + facet_wrap(~Burn, ncol = 1) + scale_fill_manual(values= nps_pal) + 
  theme_nps()+ labs(title = "Overstory Fire Effects", y = " ") + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=15,hjust=1), legend.position = "none")

# Plot 2: canopy base height
plot2 <- fire %>% filter(Status2 != "POST") %>% filter(Burn %in% c("1. Fall 2024", "2. Spring 2025")) %>% filter(Measurement == "Canopy Base Height (m)")
plot2[is.na(plot2)] <- 0

ggplot(plot2, aes(x = Burn, y = value, fill = Status2)) + geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8)+ scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + labs(title = "Change in Canopy Base Height", y = "Meters") + theme_nps()

#Stats
model <- lm(value ~ Burn * Status2, data = plot2)
emm <- emmeans(model, ~Status2 | Burn)
contr <- contrast(emm, method = "pairwise") %>% as.data.frame()
contr <- contr %>%mutate(label = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",TRUE ~ "")) %>%filter(label != "")

y_positions <- plot2 %>%group_by(Burn) %>%summarise(y_pos = max(value) * 1.1, .groups = "drop")
sig_df <- left_join(contr, y_positions,by = "Burn")

#Now add this to plot
ggplot(plot2, aes(x = Burn, y = value, fill = Status2)) + geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8)+ scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + labs(title = "Change in Canopy Base Height", y = "Meters") + theme_nps() +  geom_text(data = sig_df, aes(x = Burn, y = y_pos, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6)
```

## Part C: TLS Modeling
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

1 - Scorch Height
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(leaps)
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
pred <- read.csv("Data/tls models/pred_burnseverity.csv")%>% dplyr::select(-1)
vars <- read.csv("Data/tls models/vars_burnseverity.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-1)
temp_data <- cbind(pred, vars)
 
temp_data <- temp_data %>% filter(MonStatus != "PR01") %>% filter(MonStatus != "YR01") %>% filter(!grepl("EC_", MacroPlot.Name))
temp_data <- temp_data %>% slice(-c(19:21, 35:36))
temp_data <- temp_data %>% slice(-c(1, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 20, 22, 24, 28, 31))
temp_data <- temp_data %>% slice(-c(17, 19, 20))

# Now I have my data filtered the way I want it, separate pred and vars back out
pred <- temp_data %>% dplyr::select(1:24)
vars <- temp_data %>% dplyr::select(25:277)

# Run the following chunk so that the vars data is formatted correctly for modeling
vars <- vars %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>% dplyr::select(where(~!is.factor(.) || nlevels(.) > 1)) %>% dplyr::select(where(~sum(is.na(.)) == 0))
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
set.seed(123)
sample_size <- floor(0.1 * nrow(vars))
test_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(vars)), size = sample_size)
train_vars <- vars[-test_indices, ]
test_vars <- vars[test_indices, ]
train_pred <- pred[-test_indices, ]
test_pred <- pred[test_indices, ]


regfit = regsubsets(train_pred$MaxScHt~., train_vars,  nvmax = 3 , method = "seqrep", really.big = T) 

# Visual checks to see how many variables you should use
regsum<- summary(regfit)
plot(regsum$rsq, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$rss, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$bic, type = "l") 
which.min(regsum$bic) 
plot(regfit, scale = "r2") 

# Change # to best model
vcov(regfit,2) 
coef(regfit,3)



attach(train_vars)
# put the selected predictor variables in the model after the "~" seperated by "+" and run the model
lm1 <- lm(formula = train_pred$MeanScHt ~  h_ground_cnt   +   hr0_10_l1_cnt+ hr100_1000_l1_mean )
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
summary(lm1)
r2(lm1) 
rmse(lm1) 

check_model(lm1)


lm_out <- predict.lm(lm1, vars)
data<-data.frame(x=lm_out, y=pred$MeanScHt)

ggplot(data,aes(x,y)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method='lm', se=FALSE,, color ="black" ) +theme_light() + scale_color_manual(values = nps_pal)+
  labs(x='Predicted Values', y='Observed Values', title='Max Canopy Scorch Height') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=20, face='bold')) + theme_nps()
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Plot your model


BS <- cbind(pred, data)
BS <- BS %>% dplyr::select(c(x, y, MacroPlot.Name, MonStatus)) %>% 
  mutate(burn = case_when(MacroPlot.Name %in% c("BME_RAP001", "BME_RAP003", "BME_RAP004", "BME_RAP006", "BME_RAP009", "BME_RAP010", "BME_RAP002") ~ "Fall 2024",
                          MacroPlot.Name %in% c("BME_RAP013", "BME_RAP015", "BME_RAP016", "BME_RAP014", "FPIPS1T02:08", "FPIPS1T02:16") ~ "Spring 2025",
                          MacroPlot.Name %in% c( "FPIPS1T02:01", "FPIPS1T02:05", "FPIPS1T02:02") ~ "BM Fall 2025",
                          MacroPlot.Name %in% c("FPIPS1T02:14", "FPIPO1T09:09", "FPIPO1T09:27") ~ "HQ Fall 2025"))
BS <- BS %>% slice(-c(2,4,6))
BS <- BS %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(x,y), names_to = "type", values_to = "value")
BS <- BS %>% mutate(type = case_when(type == "x" ~ "Predicted", type == "y" ~ "Observed"))

sum <- BS %>% group_by( burn, type ) %>% summarise(max = max(value), min = min(value), median = median(value), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value)) %>% 
  ungroup()

sum$burn <- factor(sum$burn, levels = c("Fall 2024", "Spring 2025", "BM Fall 2025", "HQ Fall 2025"))

ggplot(sum, aes(x = burn, y = mean, fill = type)) + geom_col(alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge()) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean-sd, 0), ymax = mean + sd), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.3) + scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + labs(title="Canopy Scorch Height", y="Height (m)", fill = "Data Type") +theme_nps() +theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))












```


2 - Substrate burn severity
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(leaps)
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
pred <- read.csv("Data/tls models/pred_burnseverity.csv")%>% dplyr::select(-1)
vars <- read.csv("Data/tls models/vars_burnseverity.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-1)
temp_data <- cbind(pred, vars)
 
temp_data <- temp_data %>% filter(MonStatus != "PR01") %>% filter(MonStatus != "YR01") %>% filter(!grepl("EC_", MacroPlot.Name))
temp_data <- temp_data %>% slice(-c(19:21, 35:36))
temp_data <- temp_data %>% slice(-c(1, 5, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 20, 22, 24, 28, 31))


# Now I have my data filtered the way I want it, separate pred and vars back out
pred <- temp_data %>% dplyr::select(1:24)
vars <- temp_data %>% dplyr::select(25:277)

# Run the following chunk so that the vars data is formatted correctly for modeling
vars <- vars %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>% dplyr::select(where(~!is.factor(.) || nlevels(.) > 1)) %>% dplyr::select(where(~sum(is.na(.)) == 0))
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
set.seed(123)
sample_size <- floor(0.1 * nrow(vars))
test_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(vars)), size = sample_size)
train_vars <- vars[-test_indices, ]
test_vars <- vars[test_indices, ]
train_pred <- pred[-test_indices, ]
test_pred <- pred[test_indices, ]


regfit = regsubsets(train_pred$SubSev~., train_vars,  nvmax = 3 , method = "seqrep", really.big = T) 

# Visual checks to see how many variables you should use
regsum<- summary(regfit)
plot(regsum$rsq, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$rss, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$bic, type = "l") 
which.min(regsum$bic) 
plot(regfit, scale = "r2") 

# Change # to best model
vcov(regfit,2) 
coef(regfit,3)

#s_l2_na_per       LF_SLPD
#s_l2_prop_mn fine_l1_skew      LF_SLPD 

attach(train_vars)
# put the selected predictor variables in the model after the "~" seperated by "+" and run the model
lm1 <- lm(formula = train_pred$SubSev ~  h_ground_cnt   +  h_ng_vari    +  h_l2_cnt )
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
summary(lm1)
r2(lm1) 
rmse(lm1) 

check_model(lm1)


lm_out <- predict.lm(lm1, vars)
data<-data.frame(x=lm_out, y=pred$SubSev)

ggplot(data,aes(x,y)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method='lm', se=FALSE,, color ="black" ) +theme_light() + scale_color_manual(values = nps_pal)+
  labs(x='Predicted Values', y='Observed Values', title='Substrate Burn Severity') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=20, face='bold')) + theme_nps()
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Plot your model


BS <- cbind(pred, data)
BS <- BS %>% dplyr::select(c(x, y, MacroPlot.Name, MonStatus)) %>% 
  mutate(burn = case_when(MacroPlot.Name %in% c("BME_RAP001", "BME_RAP003", "BME_RAP004", "BME_RAP006", "BME_RAP009", "BME_RAP010", "BME_RAP002") ~ "Fall2024",
                          MacroPlot.Name %in% c("BME_RAP013", "BME_RAP015", "BME_RAP016", "BME_RAP014", "FPIPS1T02:08", "FPIPS1T02:16") ~ "Spring2025",
                          MacroPlot.Name %in% c("FPIPS1T02:14", "FPIPS1T02:01", "FPIPS1T02:05", "FPIPS1T02:02", "FPIPO1T09:09", "FPIPO1T09:27") ~ "Fall2025"))

BS <- BS %>% slice(-c(2,5))
BS <- BS %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(x,y), names_to = "type", values_to = "value")
BS <- BS %>% mutate(type = case_when(type == "x" ~ "Predicted", type == "y" ~ "Observed"))

sum <- BS %>% group_by( burn, type ) %>% summarise(max = max(value), min = min(value), median = median(value), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value)) %>% 
  ungroup()

sum$burn <- factor(sum$burn, levels = c("Fall2024", "Spring2025", "Fall2025"))

ggplot(sum, aes(x = burn, y = mean, fill = type)) + geom_col(alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge()) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean-sd, 0), ymax = mean + sd), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.3) + scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1,2,3,4,5), labels = c("Heavily Burned", "Moderately Burned", "Lightly Burned", "Scorched", "Unburned")) + 
  labs(title="Substrate Burn Severity", y="Avg. Burn Severity", fill = "Data Type") +theme_nps() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1), axis.text.y=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))
```

3. Fuel Consumption
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(leaps)
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
pred <- read.csv("Data/tls models/rx_fuels_pred.csv")%>% dplyr::select(-1) %>% slice(-c(30))
vars <- read.csv("Data/tls models/rx_fuels_vars.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-1)%>% slice(-c(30))


# Run the following chunk so that the vars data is formatted correctly for modeling
vars <- vars %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>% dplyr::select(where(~!is.factor(.) || nlevels(.) > 1)) %>% dplyr::select(where(~sum(is.na(.)) == 0))
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
set.seed(123)
sample_size <- floor(0.1 * nrow(vars))
test_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(vars)), size = sample_size)
train_vars <- vars[-test_indices, ]
test_vars <- vars[test_indices, ]
train_pred <- pred[-test_indices, ]
test_pred <- pred[test_indices, ]


regfit = regsubsets(train_pred$TotalAll~., train_vars,  nvmax = 3 , method = "seqrep", really.big = T) 

# Visual checks to see how many variables you should use
regsum<- summary(regfit)
plot(regsum$rsq, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$rss, type = "l") 
plot(regsum$bic, type = "l") 
which.min(regsum$bic) 
plot(regfit, scale = "r2") 

# Change # to best model
vcov(regfit,2) 
coef(regfit,3)

#s_l2_na_per       LF_SLPD
#s_l2_prop_mn fine_l1_skew      LF_SLPD 

attach(train_vars)
# put the selected predictor variables in the model after the "~" seperated by "+" and run the model
lm1 <- lm(formula = train_pred$TotalAll ~  s_l3_prop_ku   +  hr0_10_l1_tgi +hr100_1000_l1_tgi )
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
summary(lm1)
r2(lm1) 
rmse(lm1) 

check_model(lm1)


lm_out <- predict.lm(lm1, vars)
data<-data.frame(x=lm_out, y=pred$TotalAll)

ggplot(data,aes(x,y)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method='lm', se=FALSE,, color ="black" ) +theme_light() + scale_color_manual(values = nps_pal)+
  labs(x='Predicted Values', y='Observed Values', title='Total Fuel Load (tons/acre)') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=20, face='bold')) + theme_nps()
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Plot your model

BS <- cbind(pred, data)
BS <- BS %>% dplyr::select(c(x, y, Macroplot, MonStatus)) %>% 
  mutate(burn = case_when(Macroplot %in% c("BME_RAP001", "BME_RAP003", "BME_RAP004", "BME_RAP006", "BME_RAP009", "BME_RAP010", "BME_RAP002") ~ "Fall 2024",
                          Macroplot %in% c("BME_RAP013", "BME_RAP015", "BME_RAP016", "BME_RAP014", "FPIPS1T02:08", "FPIPS1T02:16") ~ "Spring 2025",
                          Macroplot %in% c( "FPIPS1T02:01", "FPIPS1T02:05", "FPIPS1T02:02") ~ "BM Fall 2025",
                          Macroplot %in% c("FPIPS1T02:14", "FPIPO1T09:09", "FPIPO1T09:27") ~ "HQ Fall 2025"))

BS <- BS %>% mutate(MonStatus = case_when(grepl("PRE", MonStatus) ~ "PRE", 
                                          grepl("POST", MonStatus) ~ "POST"))
BS <- BS %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(x,y), names_to = "type", values_to = "value")
BS <- BS %>% mutate(type = case_when(type == "x" ~ "Predicted", type == "y" ~ "Observed"))

sum <- BS %>% group_by( burn, type, MonStatus ) %>% summarise(max = max(value), min = min(value), median = median(value), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value)) %>% 
  ungroup()

sum$MonStatus <- factor(sum$MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST"))
sum$burn <- factor(sum$burn, levels = c("Fall 2024", "Spring 2025", "BM Fall 2025", "HQ Fall 2025"))



ggplot(sum, aes(x = MonStatus, y = mean, fill = type)) + geom_col(alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge()) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean-sd, 0), ymax = mean + sd), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.3) + facet_wrap(~burn, ncol = 1) + scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + 
  labs(title="Total Fuel Load", y="tons/acre", x = "Monitoring Status", fill = "Data Type") +theme_nps() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1), legend.position = "bottom")

BS <- cbind(pred, data)

  mutate(burn = case_when(Macroplot %in% c("BME_RAP001", "BME_RAP003", "BME_RAP004", "BME_RAP006", "BME_RAP009", "BME_RAP010", "BME_RAP002") ~ "Fall2024",
                          Macroplot %in% c("BME_RAP013", "BME_RAP015", "BME_RAP016", "BME_RAP014", "FPIPS1T02:08", "FPIPS1T02:16") ~ "Spring2025",

  ungroup()

ggplot(sum, aes(x = burn, y = mean, fill = Type)) + geom_col(alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge()) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean-sd, 0), ymax = mean + sd, ), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.3) +  scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) + 
  labs(title="Fuel Reduction", y="Percent Fuel Reduction", x = "Burn", fill = "Data Type") +theme_nps() +

ggplot(BS, aes(x = burn, y = PctChange, fill = Type)) + geom_boxplot()
```
